title: Poor papa!
html_source: Ophelia’s suicide triggers the awful thought of Bloom’s father taking his own life.

anchor.prefix: t. Hello. Leah tonight. Mrs Bandmann Palmer. Like to see her again in that. Hamlet she played last night. Male impersonator. Perhaps he was a woman. Why Ophelia committed suicide.
anchor.suffix: How he used to talk of Kate Bateman in that. Outside the Adelphi in London waited all the afternoon to get in. Year before I was born that was: sixtyfive. And Ristori in Vienna. W
